text:
Maya: FYI noticed 99th latency uptick on canary after kernel-priority flip. Small prompts (<64 tokens) up ~12ms. cc @Liam @Tara
Liam: Hmm, which kernel ordering did canary pick? old->optimized? any perf traces?
Maya: canary used ['fast-attn-v2','matmul-fallback'] (rolled yesterday). quick trace attached.
Maya: ```
config:
  admission:
    token_budget_targets:
      '<64': 48
      '64-256': 128
  kernel_order:
    - fast-attn-v2
    - matmul-fallback
kv:
  prefetch: true
```
Maya: logs: `decode_ms p50/p95/p99` pre: `8/24/60` -> post: `9/28/72`
Tara: could be KV eviction / prefetch thrash for short prompts. fast-attn-v2 has smaller warmup but worse KV access pattern.
Jonah: can we repro with classification of prompts into length+decode_rate buckets? run `./tools/profiler --bucket-by length,decode_rate --sample 5k`
perf-bot: alert: kernel-priority-change triggered regression detector (score 0.12) — linked perf dashboard https://perf.redwood/xyz
Liam: ok rollback kernel ordering on canary, but also let's try increasing token_budget for '<64' to 64 and enable `batch_cohorting: true`
Maya: plan: (1) rollback, (2) run 2-hour experiment with token_budget '<64':64 and collect decode_rate buckets, (3) rerun kernel-selector with fresh profiles. I'll run step1 now.
Tara: add tracepoints for KV hits/misses and batch formation sizes pls
Jonah: I'll prepare the prof command and a small synthetic workload (short prompts with varying decode_rate) and post results later today
Maya: thanks — will update thread with dashboards + short csv of cohort sizes :thumbsup:
